description: This file is a C source file implementing parts of Git's sequencer, handling rebase, cherry-pick, revert, and related operations, including configuration, message handling, conflict resolution, commit creation, and rebase state management.

classes.name: replay_ctx
classes.description: Struct representing the private state of the sequencer, including message buffers and current fixups.

methods.name: replay_ctx_new
methods.description: Creates a new replay context, initializing message and fixup buffers.

methods.name: replay_ctx_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a replay context.

methods.name: sequencer_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the configuration options for the sequencer.

methods.name: const char * get_dir(const struct replay_opts * opts)
methods.description: Returns the directory path depending on whether in rebase or normal sequence.

methods.name: const char * get_todo_path(const struct replay_opts * opts)
methods.description: Returns the path to the rebase todo file based on the current operation mode.

methods.name: int has_conforming_footer(struct strbuf * sb,struct strbuf * sob,size_t ignore_footer)
methods.description: Checks if a commit message footer conforms to expected standards, such as 'Signed-off-by'.

methods.name: const char * gpg_sign_opt_quoted(struct replay_opts * opts)
methods.description: Returns the GPG sign option in a quoted form for command-line use.

methods.name: replay_opts_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with replay options.

methods.name: sequencer_remove_state
methods.description: Removes the current rebase or sequence state from disk.

methods.name: const char * action_name(const struct replay_opts * opts)
methods.description: Returns a human-readable name of the current action (rebase, cherry-pick, revert).

methods.name: int get_message(struct commit * commit,struct commit_message * out)
methods.description: Retrieves the subject and label of a commit message.

methods.name: void free_message(struct commit * commit,struct commit_message * msg)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a commit message structure.

methods.name: print_advice
methods.description: Prints helpful advice to the user during conflicts.

methods.name: write_message
methods.description: Writes a message to a specified file, optionally appending EOL.

methods.name: read_oneliner
methods.description: Reads a single line from a file into a buffer, stripping trailing newlines.

methods.name: int error_dirty_index(struct repository * repo,struct replay_opts * opts)
methods.description: Checks if the index contains unmerged entries and advises accordingly.

methods.name: update_abort_safety_file
methods.description: Updates the safety file with the current HEAD commit SHA1.

methods.name: int fast_forward_to(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * to,const struct object_id * from,int unborn,struct replay_opts * opts)
methods.description: Performs a fast-forward checkout to a given commit if possible.

methods.name: enum:commit_msg_cleanup_mode get_cleanup_mode(const char * cleanup_arg,int use_editor)
methods.description: Returns the cleanup mode based on configuration arguments.

methods.name: const char * describe_cleanup_mode(int cleanup_mode)
methods.description: Provides human-readable description of cleanup modes.

methods.name: void append_conflicts_hint(struct index_state * istate,struct strbuf * msgbuf,enum commit_msg_cleanup_mode cleanup_mode)
methods.description: Adds hints about conflicts in the commit message.

methods.name: int do_recursive_merge(struct repository * r,struct commit * base,struct commit * next,const char * base_label,const char * next_label,struct object_id * head,struct strbuf * msgbuf,struct replay_opts * opts)
methods.description: Performs a recursive merge of commits with conflict handling.

methods.name: struct:object_id * get_cache_tree_oid(struct index_state * istate)
methods.description: Returns the OID of the cache tree, updating if invalid.

methods.name: is_index_unchanged
methods.description: Checks if the index matches the HEAD commit's tree, indicating no changes.

methods.name: write_author_script
methods.description: Creates a script setting author information based on a commit message.

methods.name: parse_key_value_squoted
methods.description: Parses key='value' pairs with quoted values into a list.

methods.name: read_author_script
methods.description: Reads author info from a script file, parsing key='value' quotes.

methods.name: read_env_script
methods.description: Reads environment variables for author info and updates env list.

methods.name: char * get_author(const char * message)
methods.description: Extracts the author from a commit message.

methods.name: const char * author_date_from_env(const struct strvec * env)
methods.description: Returns the author date from environment variable list.

methods.name: staged_changes_advice
methods.description: Advises user about staged changes in working directory during rebase.

methods.name: run_command_silent_on_success
methods.description: Runs a command silently if successful, printing output otherwise.

methods.name: run_git_commit
methods.description: Performs a git commit with provided options and message.

methods.name: rest_is_empty
methods.description: Checks if the rest of a message buffer is empty or only whitespace.

methods.name: void cleanup_message(struct strbuf * msgbuf,enum commit_msg_cleanup_mode cleanup_mode,int verbose)
methods.description: Trims and cleans commit message buffers according to cleanup mode.

methods.name: message_is_empty
methods.description: Determines if a message buffer is effectively empty.

methods.name: template_untouched
methods.description: Checks if a commit message was left unchanged in an editor.

methods.name: update_head_with_reflog
methods.description: Updates the HEAD ref with a new commit and records reflog.

methods.name: run_rewrite_hook
methods.description: Runs post-rewrite hooks after rewriting a commit.

methods.description: Parses the current HEAD commit reference.
